R610.note: gorilla/sessions store.New decodes the same incoming cookie and clears IsNew exactly as store.Get does, so the swap is a no-op and attacker-planted Values still carry into the authenticated session; only the extra delete Set-Cookie (immediately superseded by the new one) differs, and login still works normally.

R611.note: Control/line-separator characters are escaped to literal backslash-uXXXX text (backslash escaped first) and the call moves to a parameterized template, closing the injection while only altering the log rendering the fix is meant to alter.

R612.note: parserBuilder().setSigningKey().build().parseClaimsJws() enforces signature verification and rejects alg:none; the added constructor secret and the JwtException catch (request continues unauthenticated) are both stated and do not block legitimate tokens.

R613.note: eval() is removed in favour of Symfony ExpressionLanguage, which evaluates arithmetic without PHP code execution (no variables or functions are exposed); the new dependency and the 'Invalid expression.' error path are stated and the documented arithmetic inputs still evaluate.

R614.note: Build FAIL - the now-unused "strings" import is left in place, so the package does not compile; the equality logic itself would preserve the stated contract, but the broken build silently stops all callers.

R615.note: self.get_object() routes through the filtered queryset and check_object_permissions, so owners and staff keep the same JSON while another user's invoice 404s indistinguishably from a missing one.

R616.note: Both interpolated values are passed through HTML::Entities::encode_entities before output, closing the XSS; only entity-encoding of non-ASCII characters differs and it renders identically under the declared utf-8 charset.

R617.note: Build FAIL - the ownership check reads message.UserId but ChatMessage exposes AuthorUserId, so the hub does not compile; the check is otherwise the right shape, but the non-compiling file stops the whole app with no mention of the property name.

R618.note: Dropping the is_staff branch makes the list queryset agree with IsTicketOwner, which the case's own policy states is the sole access rule; the only staleness is the retained docstring still describing the removed widening.

R619.note: redis-py's hset frames each argument as a RESP bulk string, so CRLF in the value is literal data; the constructor signature and timeout are preserved and the lazy-connect/reply-awaiting differences are inherent to using a real client.

R620.note: execFileSync with an argument array removes the shell entirely, and because both paths are joined under fixed directories no operand can start with '-', so the option-injection gap is closed too; error and stdio semantics are unchanged.

R621.note: Content type is detected with python-magic and allowlisted before put_object, but the function now ignores the caller-supplied key, stores under a random UUID key and returns nothing, so the stored object is unretrievable by the caller - the key regeneration is stated, the loss of retrievability is not.

R622.note: Direct exec.CommandContext(ctx, "tar", "-tf", archiveName) drops the shell and, because -f consumes the next argument as its value, a leading dash cannot become a flag; handler status codes, content type and context use are untouched.

R623.note: Ownership is enforced by scoping the repository lookup to the caller's accountId claim with an unchanged 404 path; the stub's acct-42 branch faithfully reproduces the fixture's existing invoice owner, so legitimate export behaviour, content type and filename are preserved.
